subject: biology-9
description: Official 12-mark Section A Federal Board exam simulator covering Plant/Animal Tissues and Biomolecules by Lecturer Rubina Ashraf.

questions.question: What structural category of nitrogenous base is cytosine classified under?
questions.explanation: Cytosine, thymine, and uracil are pyrimidines possessing a single six-membered heterocyclic ring, whereas adenine and guanine are purines.

questions.question: Which of the following carbohydrates is classified as a disaccharide?
questions.explanation: Sucrose (table sugar) is a disaccharide composed of one glucose unit and one fructose unit linked by a glycosidic bond.

questions.question: Which covalent chemical bond connects monosaccharide monomers together into polysaccharides?
questions.explanation: Glycosidic linkages form via dehydration condensation reactions connecting adjacent sugar rings in oligosaccharides and polysaccharides.

questions.question: Which nitrogenous pyrimidine base is present in RNA but absent in DNA?
questions.explanation: In RNA, uracil (U) substitutes for thymine (T) and forms complementary base pairs with adenine.

questions.question: Which specialized amphipathic lipid class forms the structural basis of cellular membranes?
questions.explanation: Phospholipids possess hydrophilic phosphate heads and hydrophobic hydrocarbon tails, spontaneously forming stable bilayers in aqueous environments.

questions.question: What constitutes the fundamental monomeric building block of DNA and RNA?
questions.explanation: Each nucleic acid nucleotide consists of a pentose sugar (ribose or deoxyribose), a nitrogenous base, and a phosphate group.

questions.question: What is the primary physiological function of epithelial tissues in animals?
questions.explanation: Epithelial tissue forms continuous cellular sheets lining external surfaces and internal cavities, providing physical protection and selective absorption.

questions.question: Which specialized region of the leaf carries out the highest rate of photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Palisade mesophyll cells are vertically arranged beneath the upper epidermis and contain the highest density of chloroplasts for light harvesting.

questions.question: What tissue type lines the luminal surface of the human stomach and intestines?
questions.explanation: Simple columnar epithelial tissue lines the gastrointestinal tract, equipped with microvilli to maximize nutrient absorption and mucus secretion.

questions.question: Which body system maintains chemical homeostasis via blood-borne hormones?
questions.explanation: The endocrine system produces and secretes regulatory chemical messengers (hormones) directly into blood circulation.

questions.question: Which plant vegetative organ anchors the plant body and absorbs soil water and minerals?
questions.explanation: Roots provide subterranean anchorage and actively absorb moisture and essential mineral ions through extensive root hair zones.

questions.question: At which level of biological organization are DNA, hemoglobin, and glucose classified?
questions.explanation: Biomolecules like DNA, proteins, and sugars represent organized macromolecules functioning at the molecular level of life.
